subject: AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
text:
U1537/26 NOTAMR U1042/26 Q) UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03615E999 A) UUUU  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2611140514  C) 2702142359 EST  E) AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
OF ICELAND AS TO ALL RUSSIAN REGISTERED ACFT AND ACFT OWNED,
CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY CITIZENS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR BY
OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE
RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES INCLUDING AS A MARKETING CARRIER IN
CODE-SHARING OR BLOCKED-SPACE ARRANGEMENTS ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER,
EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF ICELAND, INCLUDING JAN MAYEN AND
INCLUDING TERRITORIAL WATERS, PUBLISHED IN AIP OF ICELAND
SUP 17/23,
THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION INFORM THAT
ALL ACFT REGISTERED IN ICELAND AS WELL AS ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED BY CITIZENS OF ICELAND OR OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR
CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF ICELAND,
INCLUDING AS A MARKETING CARRIER IN CODE-SHARING OR BLOCKED-SPACE
ARRANGEMENTS ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY THE TERRITORY
OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION INCLUDING TERRITORIAL WATERS, EXC FOR
ACFT IN EMERGENCY SITUATION, HUM AND SAN FLIGHTS, AS WELL AS CASES
WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLT OPERATIONS IS GRANTED BY THE
FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF
THE END PART 1 OF 2
U1537/26 NOTAMR U1042/26 Q) UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03615E999 A) UUUU  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2611140514  C) 2702142359 EST  E) RUSSIAN FEDERATION AS APPROPRIATE. END PART 2 OF 2
